cards.answer: Dr. Mundo is a health-focused tank and fighter who uses slowing bonesaws to approach enemies and empowered attacks to fight up close. He deals magic and physical damage, resists immobilization with his passive, and sustains through regeneration. Counterplay: dodge bonesaws, contest dropped canisters when safe, and create distance during his ultimate.

cards.answer: Goes Where He Pleases periodically blocks the next hostile immobilizing effect, costing Mundo health and dropping a nearby canister. Recovering it heals him and shortens the passive's cooldown; enemy champions can destroy it by moving near it. He also has increased health regeneration.
cards.counterplay: Contest the canister when safe, and follow up with immobilization after his protection triggers.

cards.answer: Infected Bonesaw is a projectile that damages and slows the first enemy hit. It deals magic damage based on the target's current health. Hitting an enemy refunds part of Mundo's health cost, with a full refund against champions or monsters.
cards.counterplay: Dodge sideways or use minions to block the bonesaw.

cards.answer: Heart Zapper deals ongoing magic damage around Mundo and stores some incoming damage as grey health, with more stored early in the effect. Recasting or reaching the end triggers nearby magic damage and restores part of that grey health; hitting a champion or large monster increases the healing.
cards.counterplay: Create distance before the detonation and avoid committing burst damage as the effect begins.

cards.answer: Blunt Force Trauma passively grants attack damage based on Mundo's maximum health. Its active empowers his next basic attack with bonus physical damage that increases with his missing health. A killed target is flung away, damaging enemies along its path.
cards.counterplay: Keep distance from his empowered attack and avoid standing behind minions he can kill.
